query: Which Fe isotope reference materials and bracketing frequencies (e.g., IRMM‑014 and matrix‑matched secondary standards) are best practice for LA‑MC‑ICP‑MS and bulk MC‑ICP‑MS in archaeometallurgy?

response.query: Which Fe isotope reference materials and bracketing frequencies (e.g., IRMM‑014 and matrix‑matched secondary standards) are best practice for LA‑MC‑ICP‑MS and bulk MC‑ICP‑MS in archaeometallurgy?
response.answer: For LA-MC-ICP-MS and bulk MC-ICP-MS in archaeometallurgy, IRMM-014 and matrix-matched secondary standards are best practice. Use bracketing frequencies of 10-20 per sample.
